scope: Offline lesson text and bilingual exercises.

lessonsRead.observation: Both imparfait form blanks carry visible subject cues (le voyant rouge / le voyant vert); chips are all imparfait persons, none alternatively correct; German 'mitten im Spülgang ausgefallen' and 'stehen blieb' are idiomatic.
Typed 'avant de' is unambiguous against the German 'bevor ich … gefüllt habe'; 'J'ai pesais/peser/pèsent' are all excluded; transfer example (pluie/enfants) differs from the washer core.

Relative 'qui' is the only subject-relative fit before 'indique'; the invoice offered in turn 4 responds to the agent's request for a justificatif in turn 3; 'auf der das genaue Datum steht' reads natively.

Delta verified: 'pour' now a choice blank; chips tandis que/puisque/lorsque cannot precede bare 'suivre', so one answer; this removes the unfair rejection of typed 'afin de', which the German 'um … zu' equally licenses. Choice 'garder' has no answer-printing cue.
Agentless 'a été préparé' recycles P6 L8–9; 'quoique' is absent from the connector chips; typed 'avant de' is forced by 'bevor ich grünes Licht gebe'; the missing part is the real complication.

Object-relative 'que' before 'j'ai gardé' excludes qui/dont/où; recall 'ajoutée' tests feminine agreement with preuve; neutral title no longer reveals the kept receipt before the file is found incomplete.
'Même si … je préférerais' recycles P2 and P3; 'lave' with cue 'laver (un programme court)' is singular-only; the unavailable model forces the feature answer in turn 4.

The deduction stays hidden until turn 3 (title and situation reveal only the learner's own size objection); 'déduire (vous)' cue yields one form; parce que + trop large is a P2 L1–3 reason, concession carried by context.
Two 'qui' subject cues give third-singular only; paid original transport vs. still-unorganised workshop-to-warehouse trip is coherent; German 'muss allerdings noch organisiert werden' is natural.
Choice 'confirmer' correctly guards the confirmer/confirmez homophone after 'Pouvez-vous'; 'vois' cue 'voir (je)'; recall 'résolu' with résolue/résolus tests agreement with masculine problème.
The two imperfect forms distinguish the flashing red light from the unlit green indicator.
Pesé and avant de correctly reconstruct the precaution before loading the washer halfway.
The receipt response uses subject-relative qui to describe the invoice naming the date.
The only pair licensed by both slots is garder + pour: garder follows dois-je, while the other connector chips cannot introduce bare suivre.
The speaker requests an estimate before authorization; avant de is the only offered complement of donner.
Que is the direct object of j’ai gardé and the proof agrees with ajoutée in recall.
The short cold wash takes singular lave after qui; the request answers the missing-model objection.
The deduction remains new information and the learner requests its rationale with voudrais and déduisez.
The two singular questions assign responsibility for transport and notifying the workshop.
The €400 transfer is confirmed before written closure; the form/choice pair vois and confirmer completes the response.

findings.issue: Accepted curricular variation. L7 explicitly practices concession; L8 acknowledges the offered model through the dialogue context and recycles giving a reason with parce que. The individual refund-and-justification beat is covered.
findings.recommendation: If two consecutive productive concessions are subsequently required, revisit this core turn.

findings.issue: The invoice in L3 and bank transaction in L10 hint at what the learner can use in response. The purchase-date check and transfer are already established; neither shows what the representative will ask. Accepted as contextual props.
findings.recommendation: Optional future neutral props include an April calendar and service file.

findings.issue: Accepted copy polish. Fragst du danach, dein Geld zurückzubekommen sounds stiff, though the refund meaning and use are clear.
findings.recommendation: A future German edit could use bittest du um die Rückzahlung.

lessonsRead.observation: The rinse-cycle breakdown establishes the same washer followed throughout; the two light states are expressed in the imperfect.
The first-load account combines est apparu and tournait. Weighing the laundry and filling the drum halfway addresses the overload hypothesis.
Je voudrais recycles a polite request and the date-bearing invoice answers the demand for proof.
The claim and tracking number follow the assigned incident, but the teaching card introduces a new causative anchor.
The repair estimate is requested without authorizing work. The past passive transfers to the notice posted outside a hall.
Ajoutée correctly agrees with preuve and gardé with reçu, while the early title and photograph supply the receipt response.
Même si + indicative and the conditional preference recycle earlier grammar. The missing model prompts a cold-cycle requirement.
The replacement keeps that cold cycle but will not fit the kitchen. The lesson title gives away the deduction, and the anchor drops the allocated concession.
The full €400 and workshop collection carry forward correctly; the two qui questions request the missing responsibilities.
The final caller verifies receipt of €400 and requests written closure. The first image prematurely shows the bank transaction.

findings.issue: P9 is consolidation with no new grammar. Instead of revisiting the P3 polite request, this card explicitly teaches causative faire + infinitif (faire réexaminer, faire corriger), with prominence in core, transfer, build, recall and rule.
findings.recommendation: Model a P3 conditional request in the complaint, e.g. Pourriez-vous m’indiquer comment déposer une réclamation contre cette décision ? Use a genuine transfer of the same politeness construction.

findings.issue: The exact plan assigns L7–8 concessions learned in P2. L8 teaches only preference plus cause although a replacement has in fact been offered.
findings.recommendation: Make the acknowledgement explicit (e.g. Même si ce modèle a le bon programme, je préfère un remboursement : il est trop large pour ma cuisine), with a genuinely different concession transfer.

findings.issue: The visible hint garder (infinitif après dois-je) prints the answer garder.
findings.recommendation: Use a meaning cue or differently inflected source, or blank dois with devoir (je) and keep garder fixed.

findings.issue: Quoique is explicitly excluded from learner blanks by the French staging document. It appears in this chip row.
findings.recommendation: Substitute a familiar unambiguously wrong connector such as car.

findings.issue: The opening image puts the unfolded invoice in view before the agent asks for proof and the learner offers that exact invoice.
findings.recommendation: Use the machine manual or a calendar showing April without the invoice.

findings.issue: The two serial-number photos, one sharper, already picture the agent’s later instruction to attach a clearer photo.
findings.recommendation: Show only the original blurred serial number or the refusal letter.

findings.issue: The specific handover receipt in the title and the caller’s possession of it in the image reveal the remedy before the file is found incomplete.
findings.recommendation: Use a general title about what is on file and show the open service record.

findings.issue: Why is there a deduction? / Warum wird etwas abgezogen? directly gives away the previously unknown staff objection in turn three.
findings.recommendation: Use a neutral title about the replacement offer.

findings.issue: The collection slip and title already identify transport as the unresolved term.
findings.recommendation: Use a title about the refund agreement and show the revised amount without the collection slip.

findings.issue: The learner can see that the money has landed before the service representative asks them to check receipt.
findings.recommendation: Show the service file or caller, with no bank transaction visible.

lessonsRead.observation: Breakdown report plus imparfait contrast clignotait/était éteint; both form cues name visible subjects, chips reconstruct the learner line exactly, transfer example (micro au concert) is genuinely different.

Passé composé event against quand + imparfait background; choice blank pesé/peser/pesais correctly targets a homophone spelling trap and the load hypothesis is not foreshadowed in situation or caption.
Je voudrais savoir si recycles P5; qui/que/dont/où chips give one correct answer, invoice offer follows the proof-of-purchase request as the beat requires.
Beat and trophy fit, but the form cue 'garder (je)' contradicts the sentence: after dois-je the answer is the infinitive, so a learner following the cue would reach for 'garde'.

Agentless passive a été préparé recycles P6 L8–9; the learner withholds authorisation with avant de donner mon feu vert; connector chips (quoique, dès que, pendant que) cannot take a bare infinitive, so grading stays single-answer.
Participle agreement with une preuve → ajoutée is noun-driven, not speaker-driven, so the recall answer is safe; dépôt here means handover, which the terms gloss correctly.
Même si + je préférerais recycles P2/P3; them₂ (model no longer stocked) is not revealed by the situation, which only mentions the long part delay.
Je préfère … parce que … trop large; the situation hints at the dimensions (learner's own argument) but not at the deduction, and déduire (vous) form chips are all distinct persons.
Selon notre accord recap with amount and take-back; 'le dépôt' now means warehouse and is glossed as such, distinguishing it from L6; transport reservation is kept out of situation and caption.
Est résolu with maintenant/enfin closes the arc; the second pattern example uses the banned British spelling 'neighbours' in the English translation.

findings.issue: Cloze cue 'garder (je)' is misleading: the slot follows 'dois-je' and requires the infinitive, so the cue implies a conjugated je-form that is not the answer.

edits.old: garder (je)
edits.new: garder (infinitif après dois-je)

findings.issue: British spelling 'neighbours' in the English translation of the second pattern example; British spellings are banned.

edits.old: The two neighbours are talking again: the dispute is finally resolved.
edits.new: The two neighbors are talking again: the dispute is finally resolved.

findings.issue: English 'to write to to have' is clumsy; and the pattern 'pour faire + infinitif' (faire causatif) is a construction not staged in P1–P8 although P9 promises no new grammar; it is used chunk-like and left in place.

lessonsRead.observation: Panne beat met: est tombé en panne + au milieu du rinçage, then imparfait contrast clignotait/était éteint with visible-subject cues and chips that reconstruct the learner line exactly; micro/concert transfer is genuinely different; German/English idiomatic.

Défaut beat met: est apparu against quand … tournait encore; pesé/pesais/peser homophone choice and avant de (only chip taking an infinitive) grade single-answer; overload hypothesis not foreshadowed in situation or caption.

Garantie beat met with je voudrais savoir si (P5 recycle) and the invoice answering the proof request; qui/que/dont/où single-answer. Independent reviewer's invoice-in-image complaint dismissed as required: the situation itself states the learner already checked the purchase date, so the learner-side document is not the staff complication; offered as optional only.

Réclamation beat and trophy fit, and the earlier editorial fixes are already applied, but the current cue 'garder (infinitif après dois-je)' prints the answer, and the pattern card explicitly teaches causative pour faire + infinitif, which is not staged in P1–P8 although P9 bans new anchors; both corrected minimally (choice blank, pattern reframed to staged pour + infinitif with faire réexaminer kept as a glossed chunk). Caption pre-shows the sharper photo requested in them₂.

Devis beat met: a été préparé (P6 L8–9) and avant de donner mon feu vert; chip 'quoique' sits in a learner blank row although staging keeps quoique out of blanks; replaced by puisque, which is equally impossible before an infinitive.

Preuve beat met; ajoutée agrees with preuve, que/qui/dont/où single-answer. Title 'Der Beleg für die Abgabe / The handover receipt' and the receipt in the image reveal the remedy that only follows the incomplete-file complication; neutral title and image substituted.

Échange beat met: même si + indicative with je préférerais, cold short cycle answers the missing-model complication; situation reveals only them₁ (pump delay), not them₂; train/bus transfer differs from the rehearsed line.

Remboursement beat met in substance: je préfère … parce que … trop large explains why the refund stays preferable, and parce que is P2 L1–3, so no new grammar. Independent 'même si required' finding dismissed: the beat verb is 'expliquer pourquoi', même si was already L7's anchor, and rebuilding the core line would cascade through chunks, recall, examples and speak tokens. Title 'Why is there a deduction?' does reveal them₂ and is replaced.

Accord beat met: selon notre accord recap of 400 € and take-back, two qui-questions after the transport reservation; chips all distinct persons. Title and collection slip pre-announce the transport complication; neutral title and image substituted; 'le dépôt' correctly reglossed as warehouse versus L6 handover.

Résolu beat met: est maintenant résolu, written closure requested; confirmer vs confirmez homophone choice grades cleanly; 'neighbors' already US spelling. Independent bank-transaction caption finding dismissed: them₁ itself announces the transfer, and the image shows the learner-side payment, not the staff's confirmation request.

findings.issue: Cue 'garder (infinitif après dois-je)' prints the answer; the slot after dois-je is a homophone spelling test (garder/gardé/gardez), so it belongs to a cue-less choice blank like L10's 'Pouvez-vous confirmer'. Pattern card teaches unstaged causative faire + infinitif; reframe to staged pour + infinitif (P7) with faire réexaminer glossed as a chunk, and replace the causative transfer example (also fixing 'to write to to have'). Caption pre-shows the sharper photo requested in them₂.

All previously required repairs verified in the current text: garder is now a cue-less choice blank (gardé/garder/gardais/gardez), pattern card is pour + infinitif with faire réexaminer glossed as a fixed chunk, transfer example reads naturally in both languages, caption shows only the blurred label; pour is the sole connector valid before suivre.

Devis beat met: a été préparé (P6 L8–9) and avant de donner mon feu vert; quoique is gone, puisque/dès que/pendant que cannot precede an infinitive, so one answer; affiché transfer differs from the rehearsed line.

Preuve beat met; neutral title 'Was steht im Vorgang? / What's on file?' and the file-number image are applied, so the receipt remedy is no longer revealed; ajoutée agrees with preuve, que is the only valid relative before j'ai gardé.

Échange beat met: même si + indicative with je préférerais; situation reveals only the pump delay (them₁), not the missing model; qui and lave both single-answer; train/bus transfer genuinely different.

Accord beat met: selon notre accord recap of 400 € and take-back, transport reservation kept out of title, situation and the revised-offer image; organiser/prévenir (qui) cues visible; le dépôt correctly glossed as warehouse versus L6 handover.

Résolu beat met: est maintenant résolu, written closure requested; confirmer is the only chip valid after Pouvez-vous; 'neighbors' is US spelling; bank-transaction image stays dismissed since them₁ itself announces the transfer and the image shows the learner-side view.
